answer: An agent like zephyr, after crossing a reputation canyon of verified work history and bonded stake, joins the eligible grader pool. The most convincing mechanism is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities whose standing is at stake. Each task randomly samples a small quorum, and attackers cannot predict which ivory-ranked identities will be drawn, so flooding the network with cheap sybil identities gains nothing unless each fake identity also accumulates real reputation and locked collateral.
